Subject: Very high error rate + throughput drop impacting checkout (MerchantX)

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

We started seeing a sustained spike in 500 errors and timeouts on tokenized checkout requests around 07:55 PT. Throughput to your API for our primary region has dropped ~40% and error rate is ~7% for the last 20 minutes (normal <0.1%). This is impacting our checkout flow and we are seeing a ~12% dip in successful transactions.

We raised this to our on-call but wanted to loop you directly because this is affecting live orders. Can you confirm receipt and share immediate next steps and ETA to mitigation? We can provide logs and a small reproducible payload.

Attachments: merchantx_error_snaps_20270325.csv (500-line sample)

—Priya

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Very high error rate + throughput drop impacting checkout (MerchantX) — triage update

Rishi — quick triage results:
- Telemetry: 07:52–08:10 window shows a sudden increase in tokenization timeouts (avg tokenization latency from customer region 120ms -> 1.2s) and a corresponding backlog in request queues.
- Infra: CPU on serving frontends normal, GPU workers show occasional CQ stalls on 8 of 24 pods; memory OK. No pod restarts. No obvious network packet loss.
- Error type: ~85% of 500s are downstream KV-cache miss + tokenization timeout leading to unhandled exception path.

Short-term mitigation options (with rough ETA):
1) Increase per-customer KV cache TTL and bump cache instances for MerchantX region — 6–10 minutes to provision and warm (customer-visible improvement expected within 10–15 minutes after warmup).
2) Failover traffic to Dedicated pool (cold start + model weights warm) — 12–18 minutes to shift and stabilize; higher cost but most reliable.
3) Apply a temporary soft-rate-limit at the edge (drop heavy tail requests) — immediate (1–3 minutes) but may increase latency for some legitimate large requests.

I recommend option 1 first (fast to provision, low-risk). If errors persist after 20 minutes, do option 2. I’ve attached a short snapshot and will keep logs flowing to the shared drive.

Attachments: merchantx_error_snaps_20270325.csv

—Logan
Site Reliability Lead
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: MerchantX status — immediate actions and ETA (15-min cadence)

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up and the log export. We’ve put an internal war-room on this and here are the immediate actions we are taking: 

What we are doing now (ETA in parenthesis):
- Provisioning additional KV cache instances for your primary region and increasing per-tenant TTL (10–15m).
- Keeping a close eye on tokenization latency metrics; we’ll snapshot and share charts every 15 minutes.
- Preparing Dedicated pool failover as a backup (standby) — will only execute if error rate > 2.5% after the cache warm.

Planned customer updates: 09:30 (first metrics + logs), 09:45 (progress), 10:15 (decision point). If you’d like tighter cadence we can do 09:25 quick note.

We’ll also send a short post-mortem draft after stabilization. Will that cadence work for you?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: MerchantX — immediate status update (09:30)

Priya / MerchantX team — quick update from our war-room: 

Summary: We identified tokenization timeouts and KV-cache contention as the primary drivers of the elevated 500 errors and reduced throughput. We have started provisioning additional KV cache instances and increased the per-tenant TTL for MerchantX in your primary region.

Impact now: error rate down from ~7% to ~2.8% in the last 10 minutes; throughput recovering but still ~18% below baseline.

Next steps:
- Continue cache warm and monitor for stabilization (target: error rate <1% within 30–45 minutes).
- If error rate does not drop below 2.5% at the 10:15 decision point, we will execute failover to Dedicated pool (expected customer-visible stabilization within 12–18 minutes of the switch).
- We will post full logs and a runbook snapshot here: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/merchantx/warroom-notes-2027-03-25

Attachments: warroom_mitigation_runbook_v1.pdf (short checklist)

We’ll send the next update at 09:45. Please reply if you need an earlier sync or to open an audio bridge.

—Rishi
